answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in willow and umber lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the mirror graph. A farm of 4815 identities would post 2152 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
